role: Homograph/mispronunciation layer for AVSpeech: strips AI-authored [[word|IPA]] markup for display, expands US ZIP codes to spaced digits, and builds an NSAttributedString with .accessibilitySpeechIPANotation hints plus same-length respellings ('live'->'lyve') for TTS.
types: PhoneticOverrides.Hint: struct — NSRange in resolved text + IPA + Source(authored|domain)
toplevel: Static lets: markupPattern `\[\[([^|\]]+)\|([^\]]+)\]\]` and three DomainRules for 'live' (live+measurement noun; your/you're/going/right now.../currently + live not followed by a location preposition; live now/view/screen/tracking/recording), each with ipa laɪv and respelling 'lyve'.

units.does: Returns text with every [[word|IPA]] markup replaced by its word (regex replace with $1); domain rules and ZIP expansion are not applied.

Calls resolve(text) to get the resolved plain string and hints, builds an NSMutableAttributedString of the plain text and adds .accessibilitySpeechIPANotation=hint.ipa over each hint range that passes isApplicable; returns it.

branches.cond: for each hint where isApplicable(hint, attrLength)
branches.effect: applicable hints get the IPA attribute; out-of-bounds/empty ones are skipped (logged by isApplicable)

units.does: Bounds check for a hint NSRange against the attributed string length: rejects NSNotFound, negative, zero-length, or past-end ranges (logs a warning) so addAttribute cannot raise an ObjC exception.

branches.cond: range location valid, length>0, and location+length <= attrLength
branches.effect: true: returns true; false: debugLog warning with range/source and returns false (hint dropped)

units.does: Pipeline: expandZipCodes(input) -> stripAuthoredMarkup (authored hints) -> applyDomainRule for each of the three domainRules (domain hints + 'lyve' respellings); returns (resolved plain text, hints).

branches.effect: each rule rescans the current resolved string; respellings from an earlier rule stop later rules re-matching the same word

units.does: Walks markup regex matches left-to-right, appending pre-match text and the bare word to an output string while recording an .authored Hint whose NSRange (UTF-16) is the word's position in the output; returns (output + tail, hints).

branches.effect: false (never for this constant pattern): returns (input, []) unchanged

units.does: Compiles the rule's phrase regex, finds every phrase match in `out`, locates the rule word inside each match (wordRange), skips it if it overlaps an authored hint, otherwise applies the respelling in place and appends a .domain hint with the rule IPA.

units.does: Runs two ZIP regexes in order over the text: explicit context ('zip', 'zip code', 'postal code' + 5 digits, optional -4) and uppercase 2-letter state + 5 digits; each match's digits become space-separated ('6 2 7 0 4', ZIP+4 as '... dash 1 2 3 4').

branches.cond: for each of the two patterns
branches.effect: explicit pattern first; state pattern second (already-expanded ZIPs no longer match \d{5})

flags.text: The state pattern `\b([A-Z]{2})\s+(\d{5})` fires on any two adjacent uppercase letters followed by a 5-digit number (e.g. 'HR 12000' — HR is not expanded by TTSTextNormalizer), so non-ZIP numbers after a 2-letter abbreviation are read digit by digit. ('PR' is expanded to 'P R' first in English mode, so it does not trigger.)

units.does: Compiles a ZIP pattern, iterates matches right-to-left and replaces each with the zipReplacement span/text; returns the rewritten string.
